tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal lhun grub steng gi chos grwa dang rdo kho lha khang bcas par bskor ba'i grangs tshad bsod nams 'bum gzugs 'char ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// su zhig mtshan gyi mi 'gyur phreng bsgrigs yan lag btud// nyer spyod mdun bdar khor yug gom pa chos 'khor du// bkod pa'i bsod nams gzugs su btub na stong gsum khongs// dog por bgyid pa rgyal ba'i rten gsum gus phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba de sras bstan la bsti stang bla mar byas// mchod cing gsol btab snye mas nam yang bslu mi 'gyur// gang phyir zhe na thugs bskyed nas bzung byang chub kyi// bzang spyod smon dgu gzhan don kho na ma spyad dam// dad pa'i zhing sar phyag mchod bskor sogs bsod nams kyi// sa bon gang btab gnas skabs mthar thug phan dang bde'i// lo legs 'bras bu phun tshogs dbang 'byor rgyal ba'i bka'// dri med lung gis bstan don sman yon bsnyad par bgyi// de'ang lhun grub steng gi bskor tshad bshad pa la/ spyir rten la phyag mchod byas pa'i phan yon/ bye brag tu rten la bskor ba'i phan yon/ skabs su bab pa bskor ba'i grangs tshad bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir rang re rnams dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dar ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten mjal du yod pa ni shin tu skal ba bzang ba yin te/ gang gi tshe bstan pa'i snying po sdom pa gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam nyams su len pa'am/ yang na yul dkon mchog la brten nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sgo nas dal 'byor la snying po blangs dgos te/ ji skad du/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka'// skyes bu don grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan par ma bsgrub na// phyis 'di yang dag rnyed pa ga la 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dal 'byor thob pa'i tshe 'dir sdig spong dge ba'i las la brtson pa ma byas na/

phyi ma ngan song gsum sogs mi khom pa'i gnas su skyes na dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra tsam yang bskal pa mang por thos par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ des na ngan 'gro sogs skye sgo ngan pa 'gegs pa'i thabs/ dkon mchog gsum las lhag pa'i skyabs kyi dam pa 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir// mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi// rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir// 'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid// ces gsungs te/ de'ang sangs rgyas rnams ni gtsang ba dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ bde ba'i mthar thug pa yin pa'i phyir/ mya ngan 'da' ba sogs srid pa min na'ang*/ sems can skal ba dman pa rnams kyis mthong bar mi 'gyur ba dag gi ngor/ ji skad du/ gang dang gang gi 'dul 'gyur ba// de dang de yi gzugs bstan nas// sna tshogs gzugs nor lta bu yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa ltar gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pas 'gro don mdzad pa las/ 'dir rten gsum gyi rnam par bstan pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir/ de la phyag dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bskor ba sogs byas pas tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa yang*/ chos thams cad kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa'i// yon gyi gnas 'ga' yod ma yin// zhes dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs rten ni/ sangs rgyas kyi rten gsum dang dbyer med pa yin te/ ba tshwa chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na// nga nyid slob dpon gzugs kyis gnas// nga yin snyam du yid byos la// de tshe de la gus pa bskyed// ces dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// zhes sogs mang du 'byung ba'i phyir/ de la mchod pa cung zad phul bas kyang bsod nams dpag med thob pa yang*/ ji skad du/ me tog gcig ni rab phul bas// de ni ngan 'gror 'gro mi srid// ces dang*/

phal po che las/ rigs par ldan pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la// sbyor ba skyo ba med par mchod byas nas// de dag bdud bzhi'i lam las rab 'das nas// byang chub bla med myur du reg par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ mdo sde myang 'das su/ dga' bo gal te skyes bu zhig gis dad pa'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung phyed dam/ bzhi cha gcig gam/ drug cha'am/ brgya'i cha'am/ stong gi cha'am/ khri'i cha'am/ klung gaṅgā'i bye ma'i cha gcig nas/ chung ngu na yungs 'bru tsam gcig la dad pa'i sems kyis bsti stang dang bcas/ rim gro dang bcas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa la bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na/ skyes bu de gnyis kyi bsod nams ni thams cad khyad par med par mnyam ste tshad med dpag tu med do// zhes dang*/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa las/ su dag dkon mchog gsum la me tog dang*// 'bras bu gser sogs byung ba 'bul byed pa// de dag 'gro ba rnams su 'khor ba na// ro mchog kun thob mi brdzi stobs dang ldan// phreng ba rgyan chen me tog char rnams kyis// su dag 'dir ni rgyal ba'i gzugs la mchod// de dag lha dang mi yi 'jig rten du// cha byad yid 'ong sna tshogs legs par brgyan// zhes sogs rgya cher bstan kyang 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas de tsam las ma spros so// gnyis pa bye brag bskor ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ mchod rten zhes pa'i don ni spyir sku gsung thugs kyi rten thams cad la mchod rten zhes bya ste/ de'ang legs sbyar gyi skad du/ tse t+ye zhes yod pa/ de'ang tsi ti dran pa'i byings las byung ba ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dran pa'i phyir ro// yang na tsi nya sogs pa'i byings las bsags pa'am/ bsag tu rung bas te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'am/ bsag tu rung ba'i don gyi phyir/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyis mchod pa 'bul ba'i yul gyi rten yin pa dang*/

bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i rten gsum gang yang rung ba yin pa'i phyir/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bsti stang byed pa dang*/ bla mar byed pa dang*/ ri mor byed pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ brjed pa dang*/ bsngags pa brjod pa'i rten yin pas na mchod rten zhes pa rten spyi'i mtshan yin la/ bye brag pa ni/ chos sku'i rten mchod rten chen po brgyad yin no// rten gsum rab 'byams la bskor ba mang du bsags pa'i phan yon lta zhog bskor ba gcig tsam byas pa'i phan yon yang*/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i smon lam lnga brgya pa las/ tha na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lan gcig tsam dang*/ phyag gcig tsam dang*/ bskor ba gcig tsam dang*/ thal mo sbyar ba gcig tsam dang*/ me tog gcig tsam gyi rgyus mchod pa bgyid par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du theg pa gsum po dag gis slar mi ldog par gyur cig ces gsungs shing*/ des na 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sogs rten spyi la bskor ba'i phan yon ni/ 'dul ba gzhi las/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dad pas// sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni gom 'dor na// 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni// stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min// zhes dang*/ rten la bskor ba byas pa'i mi de la tshe rabs thams cad du lha klu dri za mi'am ci sogs 'jig rten na grags che ba rnams kyis btud cing bsngags pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa sogs yon tan mang po dang ldan par 'gyur ba'ang*/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad par/ su zhig dad pas thub pa'i mchod rten nam// sku gzugs dag la bskor ba byed pa de// phyi ma'i tshe la dgra chen rnams kyis btud// bzang po'i snod gyur yon tan rnams dang ldan// zhes dang*/ mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i mdor/ mchod rten bskor ba byas pa yis// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// lha min mkha' lding mi'am ci// lto 'phye rnams kyang mchod byed 'gyur// zhes pa nas/

mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni// 'jig rten dag tu de bzhin gshegs// mtshan rnams kyis ni brgyan pa dang*// gser gyi sku mdog thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i phan yon rgya cher bstan to// spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las/ mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni// skye ba thams cad kun du yang*// dbang cher grags pa'i khyim bdag dang*// dpal dang gzi brjid ldan par 'gyur// bram ze sā la che 'dra dang*// tshul khrims ldan zhing mang thos dang*// rgyal rigs sā la che 'dra dang*// phyug cing nor cher ldan par 'gyur// ris bskor rgya mtsho tshun chad kyi// sa kun la ni gang smon pa// gling gzhi dag gi dbang phyug bla// rgyal po chos dang ldan par 'gyur// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung mod 'dir rgyas par 'drir ma ldang ngo*// gsum pa skabs su bab pa'i grangs tshad bshad pa la/ de ltar ji skad drangs pa'i phan yon de dag yid la nges pa'i bsod nams kyi skal ba dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba su yang rung ba dag gis dpal lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i dri gtsang khang gi dbus su bzhugs pa'i rten gyi gtso bo bskal pa bzang po'i rnam 'dren bzhi pa/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i sku gzugs 'dzam gling rgyan gcig lha mi'i mchod sdong chen po 'di nyid la bskor ba 'bum ther bsags pa'i dbang du byas na gling skor lnga brgya dang lnga bcu nga drug bskor bas/ 'bum phrag gcig dang brgya cu 'gro nges dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs kyi bsgyur bgod ri mo'i lam du shar/ de lta bu'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i sku gzugs dang mchod rten gyi rigs mang du yod pa'i rten re re la'ang 'bum ther re la brgyad cu'i lhag par 'gro ba the tshom med do// bskor tshad des tshad kyis gtsang khang steng gi gser sku rdo rje 'chang phan bde'i gzi 'od 'bar ba la bskor ba'i dbang du byas na 'bum ther gsum dang nyis brgya bzhi bcu'i lhag pa 'gro nges pas/

de dang 'dra ba'i sku tshad mang po yod pa rnams la'ang dus gcig tu sku gzugs re re la 'bum ther gsum lhag ma bcas 'gro ba gdon mi za ba'i ri mo shar/ gal te thub chen gling bskor lnga brgya nga drug bsags pa de'i tshe ma ṇi 'bru drug ma chag par 'dod pa zhig gis bye chung du grags pa'i ma ṇi sa ya gcig dang nyis 'bum bdun khri brgyad stong brgyad brgya 'gro ba zhib rtsis ri mo'i lam du shar ba yin no// da lta bskor ba 'bum ther re la dung phyur brtsi ba ni/ bskor lam nang du sku gzugs mchod rten che chung*/ gsung rab bka' bstan gyi rigs grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i dbang gis shin tu nyung tshad du byas nas dung zhes ming 'dogs byas pa yin no// rten mchod de rnams kyi nang nas logs su bkar ba mchod rten lha khang la bskor ba bsags na/ mkhan chen spyan ras gzigs dbang sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i sku gdung mchod rten kho na la phyi bskor bdun stong bskor bas 'bum phrag gcig dang lnga stong 'gro bas/ mchod rten gzhan lnga po la'ang de mtshungs 'bum phrag re dang lhag lnga stong re dus gcig la 'gro zhing*/ stong skor bdun bskor ba de'i tshe ma ṇi ma chag par 'don pa gcig gis ma ṇi sa ya gnyis dang nyis bum chig khri dgu stong 'gro ba'i ri mo shar ro// gling bskor gyi nang du ma chud pa'i byang rdo kho ma'i lcang lo can zhes bya ba'i lha khang gi gtso bo thub chen yid bzhin nor bu la stong bskor gsum byas pas 'bum phrag gcig dang brgyad stong 'gro ba nges so// de dang tshad mnyam pa mkhan chen bud+dha lak+ṣ+mī'i gdung 'bum chen po la'ang bskor ba 'bum ther lhag bcas 'gro ba shar/ de stong bskor gsum bsags pas de'i tshe yig drug ma ṇi ma chag par 'don na ma ṇi 'bum ther bdun la khri phrag lnga 'gro ba bsgyur bgod mkhas pa'i rtsis kyi ri mo la shar ba yin pas yid ches pa'i gnas su mdzad 'tshal/

spyir de dag thams cad kyang rten gyi gtso bo grags che ba re gnyis gzhir bzhag nas brtsis pa yin gyi/ de min gtsug lag khang dang*/ chos rgyal sa skyong chen po'i lha khang gsar rnying mang po dang*/ mgon khang nub shar rnams su sde dge 'das bzhugs mang po'i sku ring la rten bzhengs kun la thugs stsol chen po mdzad pa'i don yang*/ gsal rgyal gyi zhus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni// sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci song ba// de yi grangs snyed de byed mi rnams kyi// lha yul sa steng nges par rgyal srid thob// gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin// phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myong nas// tha mar skye dang rga la sogs pa yi// sdug bsngal med pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob// su dag 'di na rgyal ba'i gzugs byed pa// de dag gzugs bzang yid 'ong yon tan ldan// dbang po bsdams shing 'od 'bar nyi ma bzhin// 'jig rten dag na mig tu sdug par 'gyur// su dag bde bar gshegs pa'i gzugs byed pa// de yis lus ni dri ma med pa dang*// pad+ma'i snying po lta bur 'jam zhing yang*// nad dang mya ngan sdug bsngal 'jigs las thar// su dag 'jig rten mgon po'i gzugs byed pa// bran du mi skye mngags gzhug skye mi 'gyur// dbul por mi 'gyur rigs dmangs mi skye zhing*// dbang po rnams ni nyams par yongs mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ su zhig sangs rgyas mchod rten sku gzugs khang*// tshon rtsi sna tshogs rnams kyis mdzes byed pa// de ni bde gshegs mnga' ba'i yon tan rnams// sna tshogs ldan pa kun gyis brtsegs par 'gyur// zhes sogs sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa bshad pa rnams thugs la bzhag nas/ rgya dkar nag bal bod hor sogs las byung ba'i sku rten rnams dang*/ rin po che/ gser dngul/

ba so/ tsan+dan dkar dmar sogs las bskrun pa'i sku gzugs dang*/ ris su bris pa la'ang ldeb bris dang*/ ras bris kyi rigs grangs med pa dang*/ gsung rab dang*/ mchod rten gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs te/ de dag re re la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung ring bsrel mang po dang*/ rgya bod kyi paṇa grub lo tsā ba mang po'i sku gdung ring bsrel/ sku bal bgrang las 'das pa rnams dang lhan cig chos sku'i ring bsrel/ gzungs sngags/ bsgrubs pa'i 'khor lo bcas bzhugs pa'i rten thams cad la rgyud gzhung du ma nas bstan pa'i cha tshad las phyung ba'i bzo dbyibs bkod pa legs pa sus kyang 'gran zla ma mchis pa dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' lung rin po che dang*/ 'phags bod yul gyi paṇa grub lo tsā ba skyes chen bstan pa'i snang byed du gyur pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos gser dngul gyi bris pa mang po dang*/ bka' dang dgongs 'grel du ma par du brkos pa dang*/ par btab pa dang*/ bris pa'i glegs bam gyi tshogs/ glegs shing*/ glegs thag phyi nang gi g.yogs bcas phyogs re bltas kyang blos yul du shong mi thub pa lta bu yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang bla brang chen po dang*/ lha khang zur pa/ gnyer blon/ grwa pa 'byor ldan rnams kyis bzhengs pa sogs te/ de dag thams cad kyang mtshan nyid kun ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su mkhas shing grub pa rnams kyi lo re bzhin rab gnas cho gas rten gyi sa rdul re re'i gor yang*/ bzang po spyod pa las/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te// zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la// byang chub spyod pa spyad cing blta bar bgyi// zhes gsungs pa ltar cho ga rnam par dag pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/ rten bzhugs tshogs che ba'i rten gsum rab 'byams la bskor ba dung phyur gyi tshad du phyin par ma zad/

ther 'bum dang*/ khrag khrig dang*/ rab bkram sogs mang po'i grangs su yang bgrang du yod pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ lhun grub steng gi chos grwa 'dir da ltar 'tsho gzhes su bzhugs pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dge 'dun 'dus tshogs rnams kyang*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pas thal mo sbyar ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ bskor ba bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing yon yongs su sbyong ba ste/ ji skad du/ grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ rgyu mtshan de dag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa'i snying po so thar/ byang sems/ sngags kyi sdom pa gsum so so'i cho ga las rim can du thob pa'am/ cig car du thob pa gang yang rung ba sha stag ste/ thob pa'i bslab bya la legs par gnas shing*/ 'ga' zhig ni gzhan la sdom pa 'bogs pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa/ gzhan rab 'bring du gyur pa rnams ni gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam gyi lha mang po'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin cing*/ rtag tu de dag gi thugs dam gyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa dang*/ gsar bu bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa rnams kyang dam pa'i chos kyi thos bsam klog pa la brtson zhing yi dam gyi lha gang rung gi rnal 'byor sna re la mi gnas pa 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin pas/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo las/ bsod nams kyi dpal gyi zhing yon yongs su sbyong ba/ sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa/ kun tu yang sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa chen po'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir ro// des na bla ma dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs chen po de dag kho na la skyabs yul du byas te/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pas bsnyen bkur ba dang*/

bskor ba byas pa rnams kyi bsod nams phung po'i tshad sus kyang gzhal du med de/ skyabs gsum bdun bcu pa las/ skyabs song bsod nams 'di la gzugs yod na// nam mkha' bar snang 'di yang snod du chung*// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// des na gzhan dag gis rten gsum nyung shas las med kyang*/ sa rdo ri klung mang po bskor ba la/ gnas chen khyad 'phags yin zhes ma ṇi dung mang po 'gro ba'i brtsis 'debs byed pa'i kha ham chen pos stong pa'i nam mkha' 'dom 'jal byed pa rnams dang mi 'dra bar/ 'di dag ni mngon sum mig gis mthong zhing*/ dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa rang shugs su skye ba tshad mas grub pa 'di dag go /des na bskor ba byed pa rnams kyang ngo mtshar byin rlabs kyi phung po de dag yid la dran bzhin pas bskor ba bya dgos te/ bzang spyod smon lam las/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la// de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// zhes pa lta bu'i dmigs pa mos gus dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bskor ba byas na/ gong du bshad pa'i lung don rnams ltar tshe rabs mang po'i sdig pa 'dag cing*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon de skad bshad pa rnams thob pa ni mi bslu ba nges pa nyid do// smras pa/ skal bzang gdul byar sangs rgyas sku dngos legs bstan nas// 'gro don mdzad gang su zhig mchod bstod bskor ba dang*// dus mthar rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gzugs brnyan phyag mchod dang*// bskor ba byas pa'i bsod nams mnyam pa nyid thob pa// ston pa mchog gi 'dzum sgros chu skyes bzhed pa las// tshangs dbyangs sbrang rtsi'i mgrin glu'i lan brgyar bsngags pa la// yid ches legs spyad phyag dang bskor ba'i bsti stang gis// tshogs bsags pa la ngal brgyas dal 'byor don yod mdzod// tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i dge bas mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// rten gsum byin rlabs nyi ma'i 'od brgya 'thung dga' zhing*// tshogs zung puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i 'dab stong grol ba'i nang*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i snying po'i rnam par lci gyur cig

/ces lhun grub steng gi chos grwa dang rdo kho lha khang bcas par bskor ba'i grangs tshad bsod nams 'bum gzugs 'char ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong kun dga' 'od zer dang sangs rgyas bzang po dag gis bskul ba'i ngor/ lung rigs smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i dga' ba'i bgrang gzhi shar bar/ dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang phyogs kyi ba gam du bris pa ka l+yā ṇa war+dhan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
